title: tilia japonica
intro: Tilia japonica, commonly known as Japanese linden or small-leaved linden, is a deciduous tree species in the family Malvaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents work together to provide health benefits such as reducing fever, soothing respiratory issues, and supporting cardiovascular health.
